description:
28th October – Co-Sponsored Blood Donation Drive
On 28th October our Club co-sponsored Blood Donation Drive along with other Rotary Clubs from 9.30 am to 5 pm at CSMT Railway Station between Platform Nos 7 and 8. The drive was held in collaboration with Jagjivanram Railway Hospital.
65 units of blood was collected.
Project cost Rs 5,400/-
